hook: Your face would puff up the moment you reach space.
title: Your Face Puffs Up in Space
description:
In space, body fluids shift toward the head. The face swells while the legs get thinner, which astronauts joke about as chicken legs. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #space #astronaut
comment_prompt: Would you go to space? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your face would puff up in space.
scenes.headline: PUFFY SPACE FACE

scenes.narration: On Earth, gravity pulls your fluids downward.
scenes.headline: GRAVITY PULLS DOWN

scenes.narration: In space, those fluids drift toward your head.
scenes.headline: FLUID RISES UP

scenes.narration: Astronauts get puffy cheeks and swollen eyes.
scenes.headline: SWOLLEN FACES

scenes.narration: Meanwhile, their legs actually get thinner.
scenes.headline: THINNER LEGS

scenes.narration: Astronauts joke about having chicken legs.
scenes.headline: CHICKEN LEGS

scenes.narration: It fades once they are back on Earth.
scenes.headline: BACK TO NORMAL

scenes.narration: So that is your puffy face, floating in space.
scenes.headline: YOUR FACE IN SPACE

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: the workout astronauts cannot skip.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW
